title: 0.9.0 is released: replace the release-truth current-state claims, refresh bun.lock
description: Post-publish record for lore 0.9.0, published 2026-09-22 by scripts/publish-release.sh against Release run 35794336818 (tag v0.9.0 -> 48840cb3 -> fd712748). docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md was last updated for 0.7.0 (#99); 0.8.0 never replaced it, so the file docs/index.md points readers at is two releases stale. bun test, lint, typecheck and bun run lore check exit 0; required checks green on the PR head
